d:
A small Cessna 210 aircraft crashed into the Gulf of Mexico near Horn Island, Mississippi, on November 24. All six people on board, including two children aged 8 and 10, were killed. The aircraft was flying from New Orleans to Fort Myers, Florida. Rescue teams recovered the bodies, and the NTSB will investigate the cause of the crash.
